# FluxyChat

> Canonical agent catalog (dense playbook + sitemap): https://docs.fluxychat.com/llms.txt
> Humans: https://docs.fluxychat.com/docs/concepts · https://docs.fluxychat.com/docs/getting-started/what-to-build

Gold path: `npx @fluxy-chat/create-fluxy-chat@latest`

Live cursors: `npx @fluxy-chat/create-fluxy-chat@latest my-cursors --example live-cursors`

Gallery: `live-cursors-chat`, `javascript-live-cursors`, `tiptap-room`, `whiteboard`, `war-room`, `iot-panel`, `draw`, `deal-room`, `fleet-panel`, `game-tick`, `voice-stage`, `comments-board`.

Feeds: `useFeeds` + `POST /rooms/:id/feeds`. Copilot: `RegisterAiKnowledge` + `<AiChat />` (not `invokeAgent`). Threads: `useThreads` (not chat `parentId`).

`FluxyRealtimeProvider` = `workerUrl` + `authTokenProvider`. `FluxyYjsProvider` = `token`. JWT mint: `POST /auth/token` with `X-Fluxy-Api-Key` (`fc_…` server-only).

Cursors are WS `type: "cursor"` via `sendCursor` / `liveCursors`. Do not use `client_event` for pointers. Do not invent MQTT, Liveblocks keys, HIPAA, netcode, or a socket fleet.

---


> Multi-tenant realtime chat on Cloudflare Workers (Durable Objects + D1). MIT self-host + hosted beta.

## SDK quick reference

```ts
import { FluxyChatClient, useChat } from "@fluxy-chat/sdk";

const client = new FluxyChatClient({ baseUrl, userId, token });
const { messages, sendMessage, connectionState, retryMessage, loadMore } = useChat({
  roomId,
  client,
});
```

- Headless core: `FluxyChatClient`, `FluxyChatRoomConnection` (reconnect/backoff, history replay)
- React: `useChat`, `FluxyRealtimeProvider`
- Per-message delivery: `deliveryStatus` pending | sent | failed, `retryMessage(clientMessageId)`
- Connection UI: `connectionState` with `status`, `lastError`, `retryAttempt`, `nextRetryAt`

## Architecture (one paragraph)

One Room Durable Object per channel handles WebSocket fan-out and ordering; messages persist asynchronously to D1. JWT per project for members; Next.js console for rooms, agents, webhooks, billing. Agents emit `tool_call` / `tool_result` on the same room WebSocket as user messages.
